audit_question: Is the execution unit small enough to run and review?
execution_unit: one source branch plus behavior fixtures and source-span before/after run
required_raw_fields: behavior fixture status; source-span id; before/after source duration; aggregate q50 only after source pass
pre_run_gate: behavior fixtures compile and fail on a deliberately unsafe guard
invalid_if_missing: behavior status or targeted source-span movement
pass_condition: Behavior fixtures pass and the targeted source span collapses before aggregate p50 is cited.
fail_condition: Behavior changes, source span does not collapse, or timing moves without the targeted owner moving.
current_do_not_do: Do not use aggregate p50 to prove semantic safety.
stop_rule: prototype one guarded source change after behavior fixtures exist

audit_question: Are the raw fields sufficient to reproduce the decision?
execution_unit: one Performance Tests topology run crossing fixed wait/predicate with readiness and p90 veto fields
required_raw_fields: wait or predicate; readiness marker; resource-quiet marker; q50; p90; failures; preview/canvas status
pre_run_gate: target topology preserves current baseline artifact fields before changing the wait or stimulus
pass_condition: Predicate or shorter fixed wait preserves readiness, resources, preview/canvas behavior, failures, retained q50, and p90 in the target lanes.
fail_condition: Predicate fires before readiness, moves resource work into measurement, worsens p90, or diverges across target lanes.
current_do_not_do: Do not ship a shorter pattern wait from local q50 alone.
stop_rule: run target topology once; repeat only if failures/resources/tails disagree

audit_question: What must pass before the measurement is trusted?
execution_unit: one Performance Tests topology startup-wait grid with key-position fields
required_raw_fields: wait; run id; retained rows; discarded row; key index; q50; mean; p90; failures; resource counters
pre_run_gate: target topology preserves current baseline artifact fields before changing the wait or stimulus
pass_condition: Reduced startup wait preserves retained q50/mean/p90, failures, resources, retained counts, and early-key tails in target topology.
fail_condition: Reduced startup wait regresses failures, resources, retained counts, p90, or early-key tails.
current_do_not_do: Do not add or remove startup waits from retained q50 alone.
stop_rule: run target topology once; repeat only if failures/resources/tails disagree

audit_question: Which missing field invalidates the result?
execution_unit: one matched-stimulus topology run with tap, short-hold, held-key, and repeat controls
required_raw_fields: stimulus mode; hold duration; platform-repeat marker; retained rows; q50; p90; failures
pre_run_gate: target topology preserves current baseline artifact fields before changing the wait or stimulus
pass_condition: The intended CI stimulus is explicitly selected and preserves the conclusion across matched controls.
fail_condition: The conclusion only holds for an unintended stimulus or platform-repeat path.
current_do_not_do: Do not mix held-key and tap conclusions without naming the stimulus.
stop_rule: stop unless benchmark stimulus wording changes

audit_question: Does the unchanged baseline reproduce before the new packet runs?
execution_unit: one calibrated external endpoint joined to retained-key windows
required_raw_fields: external timestamp; key window id; trace endpoint timestamp; clock sync; dropped-frame or capture quality marker
pre_run_gate: clock sync and capture quality are measured before interpreting latency
invalid_if_missing: clock sync or external endpoint timestamp
pass_condition: External presentation preserves the qualitative cliff or bounds the endpoint gap.
fail_condition: External presentation disagrees with internal endpoints or shows a larger unseen tail.
current_do_not_do: Do not claim physical-display latency from internal trace endpoints alone.
stop_rule: stop display claims until calibrated endpoint exists

audit_question: Does run order or topology need randomization?
execution_unit: one archive join from raw artifacts to dashboard/reviewer outcome
required_raw_fields: raw artifact id; displayed q50; dashboard status; reviewer action; noisy-metric handling
pre_run_gate: policy consumer and artifact archive are available
pass_condition: Documented policy maps raw artifact movement to the same displayed/reviewed outcome.
fail_condition: Policy uses another statistic, threshold, noisy rule, or manual decision path.
current_do_not_do: Do not predict pass/fail from local q50 alone.
stop_rule: stop pass/fail claims until policy join exists

audit_question: Who can act on the result?
execution_unit: one replay schema plus one recorded or plugin-heavy workload stratum
required_raw_fields: workload stratum; replay script id; plugin/theme context; retained rows; q50; p90; failure state
pre_run_gate: replay schema has stable stratum labels and deterministic fixture setup
pass_condition: Replay strata preserve the relevant benchmark conclusions or identify narrower strata.
fail_condition: Replay changes rank order, tail behavior, or the affected workload class.
current_do_not_do: Do not generalize fixed-`x` benchmark facts to all editor lag.
stop_rule: stop product-wide claims until workload replay exists

audit_question: Can a later reviewer recompute the decision from archived rows?
execution_unit: one passive sidecar counter join against retained-key windows
required_raw_fields: key window id; sidecar timestamp; CPU frequency; runnable count; thermal/QoS state; trace/EventDispatch join
pre_run_gate: sidecar off/on control does not move retained q50/p90 class
pass_condition: Sidecar counters align with the timing-band transitions without perturbing the benchmark.
fail_condition: Counters disagree, observer perturbs the benchmark, or timing bands remain uncorrelated.
current_do_not_do: Do not name a VM/runtime/OS mechanism from trace slices alone.
stop_rule: stop mechanism claims until passive sidecar exists

audit_question: Does the observer or harness change the measured class?
execution_unit: one compatibility matrix before any public partition timing run
required_raw_fields: public import surface; subscriber ordering fixture; private/public boundary; compatibility pass/fail
pre_run_gate: public/private API boundary is listed before performance measurement
pass_condition: Compatibility fixtures and downstream import/use cases pass under the proposed partition.
fail_condition: Any public subscriber, plugin import, or ordering assumption breaks.
current_do_not_do: Do not turn private side-channel wins into public API changes.
stop_rule: stop local timing until compatibility matrix exists

audit_question: Which missing field invalidates the result?
execution_unit: one matched-stimulus topology run with tap, short-hold, held-key, and repeat controls
required_raw_fields: stimulus mode; hold duration; platform-repeat marker; retained rows; q50; p90; failures
pre_run_gate: target topology preserves current baseline artifact fields before changing the wait or stimulus
pass_condition: The intended CI stimulus is explicitly selected and preserves the conclusion across matched controls.
fail_condition: The conclusion only holds for an unintended stimulus or platform-repeat path.
current_do_not_do: Do not mix held-key and tap conclusions without naming the stimulus.
stop_rule: stop unless benchmark stimulus wording changes

audit_question: Does the unchanged baseline reproduce before the new packet runs?
execution_unit: one calibrated external endpoint joined to retained-key windows
required_raw_fields: external timestamp; key window id; trace endpoint timestamp; clock sync; dropped-frame or capture quality marker
pre_run_gate: clock sync and capture quality are measured before interpreting latency
invalid_if_missing: clock sync or external endpoint timestamp
pass_condition: External presentation preserves the qualitative cliff or bounds the endpoint gap.
fail_condition: External presentation disagrees with internal endpoints or shows a larger unseen tail.
current_do_not_do: Do not claim physical-display latency from internal trace endpoints alone.
stop_rule: stop display claims until calibrated endpoint exists

audit_question: Does run order or topology need randomization?
execution_unit: one archive join from raw artifacts to dashboard/reviewer outcome
required_raw_fields: raw artifact id; displayed q50; dashboard status; reviewer action; noisy-metric handling
pre_run_gate: policy consumer and artifact archive are available
pass_condition: Documented policy maps raw artifact movement to the same displayed/reviewed outcome.
fail_condition: Policy uses another statistic, threshold, noisy rule, or manual decision path.
current_do_not_do: Do not predict pass/fail from local q50 alone.
stop_rule: stop pass/fail claims until policy join exists

audit_question: Who can act on the result?
execution_unit: one replay schema plus one recorded or plugin-heavy workload stratum
required_raw_fields: workload stratum; replay script id; plugin/theme context; retained rows; q50; p90; failure state
pre_run_gate: replay schema has stable stratum labels and deterministic fixture setup
pass_condition: Replay strata preserve the relevant benchmark conclusions or identify narrower strata.
fail_condition: Replay changes rank order, tail behavior, or the affected workload class.
current_do_not_do: Do not generalize fixed-`x` benchmark facts to all editor lag.
stop_rule: stop product-wide claims until workload replay exists

audit_question: Can a later reviewer recompute the decision from archived rows?
execution_unit: one passive sidecar counter join against retained-key windows
required_raw_fields: key window id; sidecar timestamp; CPU frequency; runnable count; thermal/QoS state; trace/EventDispatch join
pre_run_gate: sidecar off/on control does not move retained q50/p90 class
pass_condition: Sidecar counters align with the timing-band transitions without perturbing the benchmark.
fail_condition: Counters disagree, observer perturbs the benchmark, or timing bands remain uncorrelated.
current_do_not_do: Do not name a VM/runtime/OS mechanism from trace slices alone.
stop_rule: stop mechanism claims until passive sidecar exists

audit_question: Does the observer or harness change the measured class?
execution_unit: one compatibility matrix before any public partition timing run
required_raw_fields: public import surface; subscriber ordering fixture; private/public boundary; compatibility pass/fail
pre_run_gate: public/private API boundary is listed before performance measurement
pass_condition: Compatibility fixtures and downstream import/use cases pass under the proposed partition.
fail_condition: Any public subscriber, plugin import, or ordering assumption breaks.
current_do_not_do: Do not turn private side-channel wins into public API changes.
stop_rule: stop local timing until compatibility matrix exists

audit_question: When does the packet stop needing more analysis?
execution_unit: one source branch plus behavior fixtures and source-span before/after run
required_raw_fields: behavior fixture status; source-span id; before/after source duration; aggregate q50 only after source pass
pre_run_gate: behavior fixtures compile and fail on a deliberately unsafe guard
invalid_if_missing: behavior status or targeted source-span movement
pass_condition: Behavior fixtures pass and the targeted source span collapses before aggregate p50 is cited.
fail_condition: Behavior changes, source span does not collapse, or timing moves without the targeted owner moving.
current_do_not_do: Do not use aggregate p50 to prove semantic safety.
stop_rule: prototype one guarded source change after behavior fixtures exist
